days.title: THRESHOLD TRAINER · New cycle begins today!! · Week 1 - Day 1
days.notes:
• This cycle focuses on developing race pace effort stamina. This is one of the most important cycles to reaching peak performance. If you skip this portion of training you will fall apart at then end of the race
• If you are looking to be a champion the back half of the race then this is the cycle for you.
• 20-60 minute long sweat filled workouts just below race pace to help you make the break through you've been looking for.
WORKOUT NOTES
This is a very important test. Do your best, there is no perfect score. This is an important baseline test. Wear a heart rate monitor if you can
You can do this on your treadmill, however if you do you must retest on a treadmill too.

blocks.label: P2
blocks.name: 30 minute max distance test
blocks.details:
• This is all about bringing the heart rate down and flushing the legs out to enhance your recovery time.
• It is best to negative split this run, don't have fast miles in the beginning then have sloppy miles at the end.

sessions.title: 30 minute easy run OR 60 minute hike

blocks.name: 30 minute easy run OR 60 minute hike
blocks.details:
• Make the choice based off how you feel from the hard effort from yesterday
• Some of you will have harder times recovering from speed work, ideally we want to spend more time running but it is more important to stay healthy and strong during your training. The bike is great if you need more recovery time.

days.title: THRESHOLD TRAINER · Week 1 - Day 3 · Strength Test

blocks.name: DEADLIFT
blocks.details:
▶ DEADLIFT
Take 15 minutes to find your 3 rep max deadlift.
• This is to find you max strength
• Be smart and safe with this test. Remember you aren't a powerlifter, you are an athlete.

blocks.name: WALL BALLS
blocks.details:
▶ WALL BALLS
100 wall balls for time - 20 lb (9,1 kg) men /14 lb (6,4 kg) women
• Rest 5-8 minutes after this

blocks.name: ROW
blocks.details:
▶ ROW
5k row test
• Warm up the body for 5 minutes with an easy row before you start the test. This is a muscular endurance test. Very different from your run test but just as hard, make sure to fuel properly before this.

sessions.title: 30 minute easy run or 60 minute hike.

blocks.name: 30 minute easy run or 60 minute hike.
blocks.details:
• Make the choice based off how you feel from the hard effort from yesterday
• Go very easy on this

blocks.label: P1
blocks.name: Bench Press
blocks.details:
• Take 15 minutes to find you 3 rep max bench press
• This is to find you max strength

blocks.label: P2
blocks.name: PULL UPS
blocks.details:
▶ PULL UPS
Max strict pull up test - 2 minutes
• Take as many breaks as possible. This is a strength endurance test, no kipping and no dropping from the top.
• Chin over the bar at the top, full arm extension at the bottom.
• Rest 5 minutes after this

blocks.label: P3
blocks.name: WALKING LUNGE
blocks.details:
• 100m walking lunge test 65 lb (29,5 kg) men / 45 lb (20,4 kg) women on back
• Knee must touch the ground, fully stand at the top of each rep.

blocks.label: P4
blocks.name: BAR OVER BURPEES
blocks.details:
▶ BAR OVER BURPEES
5 minute max rep bar facing burpee test.
• Each burpee must be to the floor and you must be fully facing the barbell each rep. At the top of each rep you must jump fully over the bar to the other side.
• The plate must have a 45 lb (20,4 kg) plate on each side to create specific height for the jump performed in each rep.

sessions.title: Go for your long hike or bike - 90 minutes

blocks.name: Go for your long hike or bike - 90 minutes
blocks.details:
• This effort is here to build endurance. Since we had a heavy test week we want to keep the intensity very low to make sure that you are fully recovered for next week's training.
• Keep your RPE or heart rate below 70% effort level. This will become a key session each week for you to build the endurance needed for race day.
